package.description: Command-line DRM removal for ebooks (DeDRM_tools, reimplemented in Rust)

en-US.description: Command-line DRM removal for ebooks (DeDRM_tools, reimplemented in Rust)
en-US.longDescription: flamberge removes DRM from ebooks, reimplementing the DeDRM_tools Calibre plugins in Rust. It supports the Mobipocket, Topaz, KFX, Adobe ADEPT (EPUB+PDF), Barnes & Noble (EPUB+PDF), eReader, and Kobo KEPUB schemes.
en-US.name: flamberge
